annotations.summary: More than one abnormal WebSocket close (close-code class `error`) per second across the hosts and kernels gateways.
HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 5% over 5 minutes.

rules.title: GenAiPromptCacheHitRateLow: Prompt cache hit rate below 40% (cost bleed)

model.expr:
(
  sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="cache_read"}[30m]))
  /
  (
    sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="cache_read"}[30m]))
    +
    sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type=~"input|cache_write"}[30m]))
  )
) < 0.4
and
sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[30m])) >= 200000

annotations.summary: Prompt cache hit rate <40% sustained for 30m on a model with non-trivial volume.
annotations.description: Provider-side prompt caches (Gemini implicit, Anthropic incremental, OpenAI prompt) are not hitting on {{ $labels.gen_ai_provider_name }}/{{ $labels.gen_ai_request_model }} despite >=200K input tokens billed in the last 30m. This is a cost-bleed signal, not a user-facing failure. Common causes: per-turn-mutating prefix bytes (token-usage reminders, dynamic system-prompt fields), tool-list churn, or LangChain integration regressions. See docs/research/gemini-prompt-cache-busting.md for the diagnosis playbook.

rules.title: P1: Funded LLM Pool Near Failsafe

annotations.summary: A funded LLM capacity pool has remained above 87.5% of its 64-operation abuse failsafe.
A primary funded LLM request reached the account abuse failsafe after recovery.
Funded LLM recovery failed; admission remains fail-closed without changing customer money.

rules.title: P1: Funded LLM Recovery SLO Breach

annotations.summary: The oldest due funded LLM operation has exceeded the 30-second healthy recovery SLO.
DB-only funded LLM recovery observed a provider execution; the invariant is zero.

A Tau process (app or billing worker) restarted more than twice in 30 min: it is crash-looping (F-10: billing-operations OOM-kills on a 256 MB Machine, before its first pass completes). Reads process_uptime, which exists from the first scrape. A deploy restarts it once.

rules.title: P1: Supplier Cost Above 85% of Charge

model.expr: sum by (app, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / (sum by (app, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(gen_ai_client_cost_total{service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) * 1e12) > 0.85

annotations.summary: Over 24 h, a model's metered supplier cost is above 85% of what customers were charged for it (expected about 0.77 at the 30% markup), and has stayed there for 24 h: the route's pinned supplier rate or retail price is wrong. Supplier cost is an estimate written on the terminal receipt (charter W3), live-settled operations only; recovery-settled ones are in the unpriced gauge. Grouped by Fly `app`, model and provider. Soft alert: the provider console limit is the cap (BIL-21).

model.expr: (sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / 1e12 > on (deployment_environment) clamp_min(3 * sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{service_name="tau-api"}[7d] offset 24h)) / 7 / 1e12, 50)) or (sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / 1e12 > 50 unless on (deployment_environment) sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{service_name="tau-api"}[7d] offset 24h)))

annotations.summary: Metered supplier spend in the last 24 h for one environment is above max(US$50, 3x its trailing 7-day daily mean); with no 7-day history, above US$50. A runaway agent, a mispriced route or abuse. Soft alert: the provider console hard limit is the cap (BIL-21). increase() cannot see a counter's first sample, so a new process under-counts by one call.

model.expr: (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}) > on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"} offset 2h)) or (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}) > 0 unless on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"} offset 2h))

annotations.summary: New settled operations carry no supplier-cost estimate because a route's supplier valuation is incomplete (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations with reason `missing_rate` or `dimension_mismatch` grew, or a provider/SKU/reason appeared, in the last 2 h): it needs a code fix. Cut streams (`absorbed`) have their own rate rule, billing-supplier-absorbed-usage. The gauge is a running total recorded hourly by billing-operations, so this rule watches its growth, not its level. Clears 2 h after the last increase.

model.expr: (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}) - on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"} offset 1h) > 10) or (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}) > 10 unless on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"} offset 1h))

annotations.summary: More than 10 settled operations in one provider/SKU were absorbed unpriced in the last hour (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations with reason `absorbed` grew by more than 10, or appeared above 10): cut streams or expired recoveries at an unusual rate, so a client, the gateway or a provider is aborting turns. A single client abort is expected and does not fire. The gauge is a running total recorded hourly by billing-operations.

rules.title: P1: Supplier Invoice Does Not Match Meter

annotations.summary: reconcile-supplier-invoice found a provider invoice total outside tolerance of the summed supplier cost on terminal receipts and opened a supplier_invoice_total_mismatch case. Operator work; it blocks nothing. The case evidence carries both totals and the unpriced and unattributed counts.
